The paper's main contribution is an LLM-based evolutionary search framework for kernel optimization. However, it explicitly uses RAG with RISC-V-specific context to enrich the LLM's explorations, and it runs experiments on 80 kernel design tasks. The system therefore conditions LLM output on retrieved text at inference time. Whether it counts as a RAG method is borderline, since RAG is a component and not the focus, but the rules say to include papers that propose or evaluate a RAG method. The abstract does not make clear that RAG is evaluated on its own. I lean toward INCLUDE, because the system uses RAG and runs experiments, though MAYBE is also defensible. I choose INCLUDE.
